english: Old man Matsudaira!\nWhat brings you here?
Can't do that.\nWe'll save him with Gin Tama.
The mushroom's off.\nHe should be\nback to normal now.
You be careful too.\nNo telling what's ahead.
You're the head of the police?!
Who cares about that?\fYou lot, slit your bellies!
Right! Here's the deal.\fFight me with Gin Tama!
Oh, nice!\nFinally in the mood, huh?
Come on, Hijikata. I'm busy.\nMake it quick, will you?\fI'm calling some girls over\nfor a big party.
Hey, players!\nLife at the top is great!\fWork hard and get there!
No. There's a mushroom\non his head.
Let's wrap this up\nand get home already,\nHijikata.
So what? Edo... No,\nthis entire planet\nis as good as ours.
I adjusted Botekurikokasu\nso only you two\nwouldn't become listless.
Human genetic data\nis hard to copy.
Gengai improved Gin Tama.\nWe spread them.
I'm letting you watch\nEdo's final moments.\nBe grateful.
Had to lure you here.\nCouldn't have you\nturning listless too.
Looks like the end of the line.
No. Just brainwashed\npeople I know\nand my own copy.
So there were two Darakus\nfrom the start\nof this whole incident.
Come to think of it...\nOnly we haven't\nturned into deadbeats.
I'll beat the right Daraku first!
Of course!\fAnd don't go losing\nto a guy like this, idiot!
Yeah... Seen any\nBanbanji guys on the way up?
After seeing my own copy?\nHardly surprising.
Maybe they're just pale\nand you can't tell.
Shut up!!\nWe've seen through your scheme!
Fine! Let's see who\nbeats those guys first!
I'll beat the left Daraku first!
What are you doing, idiot?!\nDon't LOSE!!
Of course I won.\nFaster than you, too!
Hey, that machine!\nBotekurikokasu, was it?\nGotta stop it, fast!
Calling yourself a bad boy\nis already out of fashion!
Like hell we'll let you\ndo as you please, bastard!
Gin Tama started this.\nGin Tama will end it!!
Like he hasn't taken\nany damage at all?!
Something's been\nbothering me for a while...\nIt's on the tip of my tongue...
Who do you think you're\ntalking to? Like I'd lose!\nHow'd YOU do?
Still... So two Copy Darakus\nwere behind everything...?
Talked yourself into a hole.\nWhy give us the answer?
Funny coincidence.\nI was thinking the same thing.
No, go ahead.\nI'll let you say it first.
Damn it! What now, Yorozuya?\nHate to admit it,\nbut he's right.\fWe're getting nowhere.
...Now you mention it...\nSomething's bothering me too...\nWhat was it...?
Can't you see? This mask\ngives me that bad-boy charm.
Yes. At full power,\nBotekurikokasu will do that\nto this entire planet!
Interesting. Try stopping it.\nShall I tell you\nsomething useful?

Bwahahaha!! Doesn't hurt!
Not even a mosquito bite! What now? How will you
beat me or stop
Botekurikokasu like that? Bwahahahahaha...!!!!
Useful...?\nHuh? This orb's a bit odd.
Either way, never seen\na Gin Tama like this...
I know what you're getting at!\nThis Gin Tama...\nWe might be able to use it!
But the transfer device broke,\nright? Then normal\nGin Tama attacks should...
No... That's...\nprobably got nothing to do with it.
Shut up!\nI just felt like saying it!
Hmm? This orb's a bit odd.
Before we got here,\nsome meddler gave it to me.\nSaid it might come in handy.
Yeah. If, like he says,\nour Kotodama attack energy\nis being transferred away...
He's gone off the deep end.
Yeah! We should be\nable to hurt him!
Gwah!!\nWhy?! How am I taking damage?!
Idiot. A machine's only\nworth something when\na human can put it to use.
Don't even know that,\nyou broken-down machine?\nI'll teach you.
What the hell?!\nNobody told me that!!
Oh, nearly forgot!\nGotta get the others\ndownstairs and run!!
Hey... Doesn't it feel\nlike nothing matters anymore?
Why not? Whatever.\nIt'll be fine.\nNobody cares anyway...
Words only mean what\nthe person saying them\nputs into them!
